source: Petsiuk, Das and Saenko, RISE, BMVC 2018; this is an independent signed covariance variant, not original RISE
input: Each current finite float32 NCHW callback input and supplied integer target, including every Quantus perturbation
baseline: Minimum scalar of the complete current CHW tensor
masked_input: x_M = b + (x-b)*M; model and masked input on same explicit device in FP32
raw_formula: o_ji=1-M_ji; q_i=mean_j(o_ji) over all 1024 masks; D_j=z_target(x)-z_target(x_Mj); a_i=mean_j[(o_ji-q_i)*D_j]/max(q_i*(1-q_i),1e-6)
accumulation: CPU float64 global mask sums, then cast raw attribution to float32
postprocess: Stage 22 exact complete-CHW abs top25%; per-channel reflect-padded 5x5 mean; complete-CHW abs top10%; signed
scoring: Unmodified official generator and scorer; evaluation seed 42; official nine images in original order; batch size 1; shuffle false
candidate_gate: Strictly higher official nine-image formula mean than same-device 8x8 reference and at least six of nine image rows improved
budget: Stage23 B candidate probe, nine images and necessary same-device reference estimated at no more than 3 hours before run
no_adaptive_tuning: Do not change mask count, grid, seed, formula or postprocessing after candidate results; do not infer E018 algorithm or claim reproduction
